title: the-loop collaborators
description: Schema for .the-loop/collaborators.yaml — the stewards of the repository (CODEOWNERS-like) and the single source of truth for WHO collaborates on this project and in which roles (issue-82, decision-035). The harness config (harness-config.yaml) references roles, never people: notifications.events names the roles a harness-raised event concerns, and the skill resolves a phase's reviewers and approvers from this file. This file declares no DELIVERY. A notification goes to a channel, subscribed by event name and configured once under the CLI config's channels.slack (issue-304); per-person routing is not built. The CLI daemon never reads this file (decision-032/decision-035).

collaborator.description: One collaborator: an individual or a group, and the roles they hold. Roles are the unit every notification filter and every phase gate targets — a collaborator declares no channel and no delivery of their own.

handle.description: GitHub handle or group, e.g. @octocat or @org/team.

roles.description: Roles this collaborator holds. Harness-raised notification filters (harness-config.yaml notifications.events) name roles, and the skill pulls a phase's required reviewers and approvers from this list.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Used by /upgrade-the-loop to reconcile.

collaborators.description: The complete list of collaborators for this project, defined up-front. RULE: every decision needs a paper trail, so at least one collaborator must hold the approver role.
